title: After the Arima Kinen: God-Tier Freedom

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Grand Prix many aspire to compete in. Every racer here today has fought to the finish with their dreams and challenges in their heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That includes Mejiro Palmer and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant… I can't take it anymore! My legs, my heart… everything feels like it's going to burst!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (The Twinkle Series is tough, but it's pretty fire! I'm still a ways off from really running freely, though.)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry I kept you all waiting so long, everyone. Did you see me run today?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm okay now. And from now on, I'll…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You're…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I just wanna ask you something! You know how you had all that pressure on you? Um…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Weren't you nervous or scared? You didn't really look affected by everything that was going on around you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Pressure? Well… I know the fans expect a lot from me. But…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I don't really know much about being nervous or scared… I don't have time for that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The only thing I gotta do is live up to people's expectations. That's what I always want to do.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: They put their faith in me, and I run for them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Faith and expectations, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (No kidding… So there's really someone who can take pressure like that and turn it into power.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap… Is that it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Is that what it means to run freely?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone has learned something today. And still, some challenges remain…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Dang, I still can't run as fast I want… I gotta figure out how to unlock my body's full potential!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No one will tell tales of me if I continue to run like this. I must train both my legs and my mind even more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Huh, so we're all the same… Although, they might be on a different level than I am…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Still, everyone's carrying something. And everyone's grasping for what they want despite that…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Great job out there. How was it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Just like I thought, I've still got a long ways to go. I'm nowhere near strong enough yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: But I realized something. Everyone single person in the Twinkle Series is carrying some kind of burden.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'm not the only one. So…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Next year, I'm gonna make sure I'm strong enough not to let this pressure get the best of me! Just like Oguri Cap!
